title: Functional French - High Intermediate I
prerequisites_raw: FSL206H5 or the equivalent as determined by the department’s French Placement Test ( https://frenchpt.utm.utoronto.ca/) .
exclusions_raw: FRE180H5 or FRE181H5 or FSL305Y5 or FSL220H1 or FSL222H1 or FSL22Y1 or higher level FSL course, all high school grade levels in French Immersion, Extended French, and French Secondary Schools.
